newsitem.title: USA: Outdoor Systems buys Villepigue assets.
newsitem.headline: Outdoor Systems buys Villepigue assets.

text.p: Outdoor Systems Inc said that it has an agreement to purchase the assets ot Villepigue Outdoor Advertising of New York for about $27 million.
Outdoor said that the acquisition includes 1110 bulletin faces in the metropolitan New York City area, which will compliment Outdoor's 3,500 bus shelters.
The company said it also has an agreement to buy 250 bus shelters in the Louisville, Kentucky area from P&C Media for about $830,000.
Outdoor currently operates 1,650 display faces in the Louisville market.
